## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by Brawl Stars with 108 brawlers, selectable maps, and win/loss match outcomes.

## Requirements
- Make it 3D-styled and playable.
- Include all 108 brawlers in the roster.
- Include selectable maps and battle arenas.
- Support winning or losing a match.

## Decisions
- Used a custom canvas/isometric rendering approach rather than WebGL/Three.js.
- Added a polished premium-style game menu and match HUD.
- Assumed a Solo Showdown format with 10 actors.
- Added desktop and mobile controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with menu, roster, map selector, HUD, and results screen.
- Created `style.css` with desktop/mobile responsive presentation.
- Created `game.js` with 108 named roster entries, 3 maps, canvas rendering, combat, bots, pickups, controls, and result handling.
- Added `start.sh` for serving on port 3002.

### Active
- The implementation is present but has not been fully browser-verified due to the last code append.
- Syntax validity was previously found to fail with `Unexpected token '}'`; the code was then substantially reconstructed in the latest file state.

### Blocked
- Browser verification and a final syntax/run check are still pending.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and fix any remaining syntax errors.
2. Start the app using `./start.sh`.
3. Open `http://localhost:3002` and verify menu rendering, roster/map selection, match start, movement, combat, and win/loss flow.
4. Capture a latest screenshot and inspect it for blank or broken rendering.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main UI structure and screens.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Complete visual styling and responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Game logic, roster, maps, canvas scene, combat, bots, and match states.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: Local static server launcher.

## Important Context
- The game is now an original “Star Brawl” themed implementation, not an official asset-backed Brawl Stars game.
- The roster count is represented by 108 entries in `names`.
- A known prior syntax error was `Unexpected token '}'` at `game.js` end, though the file was subsequently rewritten and needs rechecking.

## Objective
- Build a playable, original arena brawler inspired by *Brawl Stars* with a 108-character roster, selectable maps, and match outcomes.
- Make the player’s brawler and enemy bots able to shoot during matches.

## Requirements
- 3D-styled, playable browser game with desktop and mobile controls.
- 108 roster entries, selectable maps, and win/loss outcomes.
- Player and bots should be able to shoot.

## Decisions
- Use an original “Star Brawl” theme and custom canvas/isometric rendering rather than official assets.
- Use Solo Showdown with 10 actors.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created menu, roster, map selector, HUD, results screen, and responsive styling.
- Implemented game loop, arena rendering, actors, bullets, bots, pickups, and match outcomes.

1. Inspect and fix player shooting and bot targeting/firing in `game.js`.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and browser-test combat, ensuring shots hit actors and matches can end in wins and losses.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, player shooting, bot AI/fire, bullet collisions, and match flow.
- `index.html`: Menu, controls, HUD, and result-screen elements.
- `style.css`: Game UI styling and responsive controls.
- `start.sh`: Starts the local server on port 3002.

## Important Context
- `game.js` currently contains player shooting and bot bullet-firing logic, but the latest request to make shooting work still needs verification and fixes.
- Current UI advertises WASD/arrows to move, click/space to attack, and Q for super.

- 108-character roster, selectable maps, match outcomes, working player/bot shooting, and a camera that follows the player.

- Support mobile controls and responsive layout.

## Decisions
- Use an original “Star Brawl” theme with custom canvas/isometric rendering and Solo Showdown with 10 actors.
- Emphasize the player with increased size, a white ring, yellow marker, and name label; keep the player drawn above arena scenery.

- Menu, roster, map selector, HUD, results screen, responsive styling, game loop, arena, bots, bullets, pickups, and match outcomes implemented.

## Objective
- Complete Star Brawl and ensure the player brawler is visible and the game works on mobile.
- Fix the current bug where the player cannot move.

## Requirements
- 108-character roster, selectable maps, match outcomes, working shooting, and a camera that follows the player.
- Keep the player brawler clearly visible.
- Support mobile controls and responsive layout.

## Decisions
- Use the original Star Brawl theme, custom canvas/isometric rendering, and Solo Showdown with 10 actors.
- Emphasize the player with increased size, contrasting rings, a marker, name label, and health bar.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menu, roster, map selector, HUD, results screen, responsive styling, game loop, arena, bots, bullets, pickups, and match outcomes implemented.
- Player/bot firing, aiming, line-of-sight checks, camera tracking, and touch controls implemented.
- Player visibility and mobile-control styling/handlers were recently improved.
- `node --check game.js` passed after those changes.

### Active
- Fix movement: `blocked()` in `game.js` has a precedence error. Its obstacle test treats every box as blocking every movement attempt, likely pinning the player.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Correct the obstacle predicate in `blocked()` so collision distance is checked for both boxes and rocks, rather than always returning true for boxes.
2. Verify keyboard and joystick movement, then run `node --check game.js` and test the game in a browser/mobile viewport.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Movement/collision logic (`blocked`, `moveActor`, `update`) and touch input handlers.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and touch-control stacking/styles.
- `index.html`: Canvas, HUD, joystick, and touch button markup.

## Important Context
- Game server was responding at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The same game files also exist under `dist/`; the latest edits/checks were made in the project-root files.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Star Brawl, keep the player visible and mobile-friendly, and fix movement.
- Add trophies for wins and a Trophy Road showing saved progress and milestones.

## Requirements
- 108-character roster, selectable maps, match outcomes, working shooting, and a camera that follows the player.
- Keep the player brawler clearly visible; support mobile controls and responsive layout.
- Award trophies when the player wins and provide a Trophy Road.

## Decisions
- Use the original Star Brawl theme, custom canvas/isometric rendering, and Solo Showdown with 10 actors.
- Emphasize the player with increased size, contrasting rings, a marker, name label, and health bar.
- Persist trophy count in `localStorage` under `starBrawlTrophies`; award 12 trophies per win.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menu, roster, map selector, HUD, results screen, responsive styling, game loop, arena, bots, bullets, pickups, and match outcomes implemented.

- Fix the game’s unresponsive screen and provide a clear button for choosing brawlers.
- Apply trophy changes based on match placement.

- Placement rewards: 10th = −12 trophies, 9th = −10, decreasing the penalty by 2 per place through 6th; 5th = 0 trophies.
- Provide a button to choose brawlers.

## Decisions
- The existing `CHANGE` button beside the selected brawler already opens the roster; whether a separate, more prominent button is wanted remains unclear.

- Implement and validate placement-based trophy changes.
- Clarify or improve the brawler-selection button as needed.

## Objective
- Improve the game’s controls and arena: fix trophy updates and brawler selection, reduce the player character’s size, collect power cubes automatically, and enlarge the map with an original style inspired by Brawl Stars.

## Requirements
- Trophy changes: 10th −12, 9th −10, 8th −8, 7th −6, 6th −4, 5th 0; preserve victory rewards.
- Provide a way to choose brawlers; the existing `CHANGE` button opens the roster.
- Make the player character as small as bots to avoid getting stuck.
- Automatically collect a dropped power cube when the player is over it.
- Enlarge the map and make it like the original Brawl Stars map.

## Decisions
- The assistant declined to reproduce the original map exactly and proposed a larger arena with original styling inspired by it.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `finish()` syntax and placement-based trophy calculation in `game.js`; validated with `node --check`.
- Fixed roster search casing and touch Super handler.
- Synced `game.js` to `dist/game.js`.
- Matched player rendering scale to bots and reduced actor collision radius.
- Confirmed power cubes are collected automatically within distance `0.55`, retaining HP and Super bonuses.

### Active
- Enlarge the arena and update its original, Brawl Stars-inspired layout and appearance.

### Blocked
- Exact recreation of the original Brawl Stars map was declined; an original inspired design remains possible.

## Next Move
1. Expand world dimensions consistently across movement bounds, tile rendering, spawning, camera, storm, and obstacle placement in `game.js`.
2. Build an original, recognizable arena layout with clear paths and cover.
3. Validate syntax and play interactions, then sync the source to `dist/game.js`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Arena dimensions, rendering, movement bounds, obstacles, spawning, storm, and gameplay logic.
- `dist/game.js`: Published copy that should match validated `game.js`.

## Important Context
- Current bounds are approximately `x: 0.35–23.65`, `y: 0.35–19.65`; `drawScene()` renders a 24×20 grid.
- Match starts at `(12,10)`; bot spawn positions and obstacle placement are based on the current map size.
